title: When drum solos came in
summary: Drum solos were late; he credits Hampton, Krupa, Cozy Cole and Sidney Catlett, and Armstrong's visits.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What about drum solos? When did they come in?

Well, I remember years ago, you couldn't hear no drum on the television, the radio. That's right, you never heard. They sure late in the style. I believe what you call them, start them fellas like Lionel Hampton and this fella.

Gene Krupa like them, yeah, they start that, you see, yeah. And the center fella, I met Louie when he came down last time, that fella got the fun. Cozy Cole. Oh, yeah. Yeah. And the center fella, big tall fella. Sidney Catlett. Oh, yeah. He died now. Every time Louie come here, come see me, come the last one he played with us. Yeah, and this book they got him, last one he played.
